tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description:
What SpendQuery can answer: data coverage, metrics, dimensions (with examples and whether
    they apply to contracts or assistance), analyses, the QueryPlan JSON schema, planning rules
    and example question -> plan pairs. Call this first (no arguments): the federal catalog.
    section: "states"

tools.name: run_plan
tools.description:
Run a QueryPlan (see get_catalog.plan_schema). Returns status (ok | clarify |
    unsupported | error), a one-paragraph answer, columns, rows (max 100), the SQL that ran,
    caveats and how names were resolved to codes.

tools.name: search_codes
tools.description:
Look up codes and official names. kind: agency | bureau | state | county | naics | psc |
    program. Matches names (substring, case-insensitive) or code prefixes. Plans can use either
    the names or the codes.

tools.name: size_standard
tools.description:
SBA small business size standards (13 CFR 121.201, the eCFR table): a NAICS code, a code
    prefix (5415) or industry words -> receipts ($ millions) or employees, exceptions and
    footnotes, and the programs that use them.

tools.name: naics_finder
tools.description:
Describe the work in plain words -> the NAICS codes buyers actually use for it (codes on
    SAM.gov notices whose titles have the words and on federal contracts described with them),
    each with its SBA size standard.

tools.name: vehicle_match
tools.description:
For 6-digit NAICS codes (and an optional agency): the shared contract vehicles (GWACs,
    multiple-award IDIQs, GSA Schedule, BPAs) carrying last complete year's contract money in those
    codes, the share through each and who each is reserved for (read from its name).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_notice · Private data: get_notice, search_local_bids, sbir_awards · Public sink: vehicle_match, search_local_bids · Destructive: run_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_notice · Private data: get_notice, search_local_bids, sbir_awards · Public sink: vehicle_match, search_local_bids · Destructive: run_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
